name: enviro-paper
description: Environmental-science field-sampling paper authoring skill: QA/QC, statistics, pollution & risk indices, publication figures, IMRaD writing and polishing, citation integrity, peer-review simulation, and reviewer-response letters.

interface.shortDescription: Environmental-science sampling data to a submission-ready paper
interface.longDescription: Use Enviro Paper to take an environmental-science field-sampling dataset (water, soil, sediment, sludge, pore-water/peeper, air/aerosol, ecology) all the way to a submission-ready manuscript: validate data with QA/QC and non-detect handling, run environmental statistics, compute pollution and ecological/health-risk indices (Igeo, EF, CF/PLI, Hakanson Er/RI, Nemerow, WQI, EPA HQ/HI/CR), generate publication-quality figures, draft and polish IMRaD sections, verify citations against fabrication, simulate peer review, write reviewer-response letters, and format for a target environmental journal.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my sampling data with QA/QC and compute pollution indices.
Make publication-quality figures from these environmental results.
Polish my Methods section to environmental-journal style.
